correctness.rationale: For each one-reserve placement j the strictly diagonally dominant irreducible positive M-matrix produces a unique attracting equilibrium. Exact inverse-column formulas give T1=A(A+m)/D, T2=(B+m)/X, T3=B(A+m)/D and corresponding Y1=hm(A+m)/D, Y2=hB/X, Y3=h[B(A+m)-m²]/D. Cross multiplication gives strict T1>T2>T3 and Y1<Y2<Y3 for all μ,m,h>0, by positive-coefficient polynomials P,S,N01,N12. Independent symbolic expansion checked the critical identity N01*S−N12*P=m*X*D and positivity of every coefficient in D,X,P,S,N01,N12. Hence 0<Q23=N12/S<Q12=N01/P; the nonadjacent crossing is their strict slope-weighted mean and the upper envelope of three affine objectives selects 3, then 2, then 1 with the stated two ties. Direct rational exemplar at μ=m=h=1 has Q23=17/14 and Q12=73/36. Universal proof is algebraic, not extrapolation from the sample.
